outcome: postpartum follow-up for bladder carcinoma (lost to follow-up)
cohort: A 28-year-old primigravida pregnant woman with a history of follicular thyroid carcinoma who presented with painless hematuria at four months of gestation.
finding: A case of primary low-grade papillary urothelial carcinoma was reported in a pregnant woman with a history of thyroid carcinoma, emphasizing the need for a high index of suspicion for hematuria during pregnancy to prevent delayed diagnosis of malignancy.
mod_finding: Pathological fetal Doppler findings prompted an elective C-section at 37 weeks.
followup_time: Lost to follow-up postpartum for bladder cancer recurrence; pregnancy followed until 37 weeks.
